summary: Iteration 50 — QRU Publishing & Presentation Standard (QRU-CON-0002) + Cover Studio Sprint 1: 13/13 backend tests PASSED and full frontend flow verified. Standard, tokens (json+css), bindings, TOC cleaner, Pre-Ship Gate (clean + defective + runs), pilot before/after, and Cover Studio governance (spec_only generate, list, /file for existing AI cover, state workflow with GOLD_MASTER guard from APPROVED_DESIGN) all working as designed.

issues: Toast 'draft concept(s) generated' appears at top-right and can visually overlap the 'Set Permanent Password' banner's close (×) button — cosmetic, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: publishing_standard.py + routers/publishing.py are well-scoped, deterministic and idempotent. Rule engine returns rule_id/name/why/responsible_module/correction for every check.
GOLD_MASTER guard enforced server-side (400 if current state != APPROVED_DESIGN) — no auto-certification. AI provider failure returns fallback:'spec_only' and does NOT block publishing.
MongoDB _id is stripped from all responses (find({}, {_id:0}) + pop('_id')).
tokens.css is intentionally public (no auth) so external/CDN renderers can consume it — verified with 200 + text/css + :root vars + .type-* + .qru-callout-* classes.
seed_data_creation: Test artifacts prefixed TEST_ in cover_assets (spec-only DRAFT_CONCEPT rows). Preflight_runs collection also received CLEAN + DEFECTIVE audit records. Not cleaned to preserve audit-log semantics.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 1 acceptance criteria met end-to-end. Standard doc_id=QRU-CON-0002 v1.0, 13 typo tokens, 6 color tokens, 10 callouts, 4 reference covers, 6 cover states, 17-rule pre-ship gate. Pilot preflight_before: RETURN_TO_PRODUCTION with 12 BLOCKING_FAILURE + 5 WARNING. Pilot preflight_after: TREASURE_STANDARD_PASSED (0 blocking, 0 warnings, 16 passed, 1 N/A). Cover Studio: existing AI-generated cover (Emergent/Gemini) renders as image/png via /api/publishing/cover/{id}/file. Do NOT re-trigger AI generation in tests — always use mode='spec_only' to conserve LLM spend.
